body.flop_note: Per neuron, non-refractory path (amortized): adapt_decay mul; (v_rest-vm)*leak; +gain*acc; -w. Spike path / atomics excluded from FLOP count (control + atomics).

notes: Accounting from rse-hpc-lab/exercises/08-connectome-lif/connectome_kernels.cuh k_integrate — per-neuron lower bound on DRAM traffic.
29 bytes / 6 FLOPs ⇒ 0.2069 flop/byte. Ridge sm_120 ≈ 60 ⇒ deeply memory-bound (correct for LIF integrate).
Spike queue atomics + hash stim are latency/control — not added to FLOP numerator on purpose.
known_limits: Refractory path does fewer FLOPs and still touches the same traffic — intensity is an upper bound on arithmetic density.
peak_tflops on machine file is estimate until measured.
